### Checklist

**Shape.** Draft, `Fixes #34740`. The body and the changeset both carry `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the claim. The body says which arm of ruling A it took: one key for all four routes, not a reword of both.

**Scope.** Every source path is inside the claim plus the amendment:

- `UserFilters.tsx`: the empty-options literal only.
- `ObjectDataPage.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `RecordFormPage.tsx`: the absence face only. `objectViewChrome.tsx` needs no edit, since it already drew the key that is reworded. The `packageDisabled` arm is untouched.
- The 11 locale packs: one value changed and one key retired in each, nothing else.

The two i18n test edits (`de-quote-pairing-3876`, `residue-namespaces-3546`) sit outside the literal surface, but the key retirement forces both. I judge them in scope.

**Changeset.** Patches app-shell, plugin-list and i18n (the three packages whose src moved) plus `@object-ui/console`, which ships the SPA bundle, as sibling changesets do. Its text matches the diff.

**Code.**

- All four faces now draw `console.objectView.objectNotFoundDescription` with `objectName`. The sentence neither asserts nor reveals existence, as ruling 6787890900 and the amendment require.
- `empty.objectNotFoundDescription` has no non-test reader left at this head. I grepped the whole tree, docs and skills included.
- The filter reads `tt('fields.options.empty', 'No options available')`. `tt` is the `useSafeTranslate()` bound in the same component at :622. The key exists in all 11 packs (zh-Hans 暂无可选项, zh-Hant 暫無可選項, ja 選択できる項目がありません, and so on), so it adds no new key. Its meaning ("this field has no options") is the right one. `lookup.noOptions` is the search-miss wording.
- The new testids reuse the existing `object-not-found` and add `filter-options-empty-FIELD`.

**Tests.** The commands are real and exit codes are recorded.

- The new pins cover list, data, create and record in en and zh-CN, for a withheld name and a missing name. They check that both are byte-identical once the name is removed.
- Four ablations went red on their own cells, each restored to blob == HEAD. The report says honestly that the route cells read the pack, so only the premise cell pins the wording.
- `user-filter-arity-spec-parity` moving to the testid closes a vacuous pass.
- App-shell was run narrowed (declared). CI Test UI 1–16 ran it in full on this head: all green.

**Docs.** None made false. **UI strings.** The changed value is in all 11 packs, zh-CN and en included. **Unrelated files.** None.

None.

### Should-fix

None.

### Notes

- **N1, zh quote style (nit, pre-existing).** zh-Hans and zh-Hant keep straight `"` around the name, inherited from the list key. The retired record sentence used full-width `“ ”`, and so do de, fr, ja and ru in their own styles. So the record and create faces lose their curly quotes in Chinese. This is cosmetic, and the de-quote ledger pins only de. A later quote pass can take it.
- **N2, readings on the pre-merge head.** The live readings and most local runs are at b3b165f7de. The merged head 4cc572c212 adds only main. The remerge-diff is empty and the file list is unchanged, and the i18n package, the five pins and the i18n gates were re-run on it. That is enough.
- **N3, eager closure.** It is NOT MEASURED locally, as declared. Build & E2E UI is green on this sha (the gzip ceiling guard that was red on b3b165f7de because main moved the ceiling). The raw en delta is −136 B.
- **N4, de span count.** `de-quote-pairing-3876` now pins 118 paired spans. A sibling that touches a German quoted span rebases it, as the PR's Acceptance notes say.
